title: Implement command dispatcher enforcing state machine rules
description:
Implement dispatch(ctx: &mut SessionContext, cmd: Command) -> Response: routes each command to its handler, checks preconditions (auth state, group selected), and returns the appropriate error response if preconditions fail. ARTICLE/HEAD/BODY/STAT/NEXT/LAST require GroupSelected or a message-ID argument. POST requires auth if auth_required. Artifact: reader/src/session/dispatch.rs.

Acceptance: every RFC 3977 precondition encoded in dispatch; unit test matrix: each command x each state -> correct response code; no business logic in dispatcher (just routing and state checks)
